title: Light or dark: making Depot comfortable
intro: Click the sun or moon icon in the top bar to switch light and dark.

sections.heading: The quick way
steps: Click the sun or moon icon at the right of the top bar. Depot switches right away.

sections.heading: More choices in Settings
text: Click the gear in the top bar. **Settings** opens on **Profile & appearance**.
steps: Under **Mode**, click **Light**, **Auto** or **Dark**. **Auto** follows your computer.
Click a colour card under **Scheme** to use it on this device.
Click **Use the workspace scheme** to go back to your company's colours.
sections.tip: On the same page, click **Upload photo** to add your picture, type your name in **Full name**, then click **Save profile**.
